mapper.select: SELECT c.child_id AS childId, c.birth_status AS birthStatus, c.expected_birth_date AS expectedBirthDate, c.birth_date AS birthDate FROM child c WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent cp JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cp.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.member_type = 'PARENT' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND cp.child_id = #{childId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO child_checklist_item ( child_id, checklist_item_template_id, status, completed_by_member_id, completed_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{childId}, template.checklist_item_template_id, 'PENDING', NULL, NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM checklist_item_template template WHERE template.lifecycle_stage = #{lifecycleStage} AND template.is_active = 1
mapper.select:
SELECT progress.child_checklist_item_id AS checklist_item_id, template.checklist_item_template_id AS checklist_item_template_id, template.template_key, template.category, template.title AS template_title, template.description AS template_description, template.detail_content AS template_content, template.action_type, template.action_url, template.info_title, template.info_notice, progress.status, progress.completed_at, template.item_order AS template_order,
detail.checklist_item_detail_id, detail.title AS detail_title, detail.description AS detail_description, detail.action_label, detail.external_url, detail.detail_content, detail.item_order AS detail_order
FROM child_checklist_item progress
INNER JOIN checklist_item_template template ON template.checklist_item_template_id = progress.checklist_item_template_id
LEFT JOIN checklist_item_detail detail ON detail.checklist_item_template_id = template.checklist_item_template_id
WHERE progress.child_id = #{childId} AND template.lifecycle_stage = #{lifecycleStage} AND template.is_active = 1
ORDER BY CASE WHEN progress.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, template.item_order, template.checklist_item_template_id, detail.item_order, detail.checklist_item_detail_id

SELECT cci.child_checklist_item_id AS checklist_item_id, cci.child_id, cci.status, cci.completed_at FROM child_checklist_item cci INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cci.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN checklist_item_template cit ON cit.checklist_item_template_id = cci.checklist_item_template_id AND cit.is_active = 1 WHERE cci.child_checklist_item_id = #{checklistItemId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT cci.child_checklist_item_id AS checklist_item_id, cci.child_id, cci.status, cci.completed_at FROM child_checklist_item cci INNER JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cci.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN checklist_item_template cit ON cit.checklist_item_template_id = cci.checklist_item_template_id AND cit.is_active = 1 WHERE cci.child_checklist_item_id = #{checklistItemId}
mapper.update: UPDATE child_checklist_item SET status = #{status}, completed_by_member_id = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN #{completedByMemberId} ELSE NULL END, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE child_checklist_item_id = #{checklistItemId}
